title: OpenAI backs Illinois bill that would limit when AI labs can be held liable
cleaned_content: OpenAI is supporting an Illinois bill that aims to limit the legal liability of AI labs for harms caused by their models. This initiative seeks to provide a regulatory safe harbor, protecting developers from lawsuits unless negligence or intentional wrongdoing is proven. The practical implication is a potential reduction in legal risk for model providers, which could accelerate AI development but also raises concerns about accountability for AI harms.

title: US summons bank bosses over cyber risks from Anthropic's latest AI model
cleaned_content: The US government has reportedly convened bank executives to discuss potential cybersecurity risks stemming from Anthropic's newest AI model, likely referring to Claude Mythos. This highlights growing regulatory concern over the deployment of highly capable LLMs in critical financial infrastructure, specifically regarding their potential for generating or identifying vulnerabilities. A key takeaway is the increasing scrutiny on advanced AI models for their systemic risk, beyond just their beneficial applications.
